name: autism-self-coach
title_zh: 自闭症成年人要的直球话术与感官调节方案
tagline_zh: 不劝你「多社交就好了」，也不假装是治疗。你说不清怎么跟老板提降噪耳机、怎么在耗竭前喊停。
tagline_en: No "just socialize more." Not therapy. You get word-for-word scripts for asking your boss for accommodations.
desc_en: Personal coaching for autistic teens and adults — self-advocacy, masking and burnout management, sensory regulation, workplace and school accommodations, scripts for hard conversations, and processing late diagnosis. Direct, literal tone with concrete output (scripts, accommodation language, regulation plans), not therapy. TRIGGERS: first-person queries from anyone identifying as autistic, neurodi
why_zh: 语气直白、字面、不绕弯，输出是脚本、申请措辞、调节计划这类能直接用的东西，而不是让你「自我觉察」。
why_en: Literal, direct tone. Output is scripts, accommodation wording, and regulation plans you can use as-is — not vague.
limit_zh: 只面向自我认同为自闭症的第一人称提问，不诊断、不做治疗；给的是话术与调节方案，不替你发邮件、不代你和 HR 谈。
limit_en: First-person queries from self-identified autistic users only. No diagnosis or therapy; gives scripts and plans, won't send emails or negotiate for.
title_en: Direct scripts and sensory plans for autistic adults
